note: Rank ladder for the found counter on My Marvel. minPct = share of all hidden details (deleted scenes + callbacks + rabbit holes) a visitor must open to hold the rank; 100 means every one. Edit titles, reasons or thresholds here; keep ids unique and lowercase. Reasons must be checkable: name the film where it is shown.

ranks.title: Civilian
ranks.reason: Everyone starts here: you've seen the movies, now you're starting to notice things.

ranks.title: Spider-Man
ranks.reason: A teenager from Queens pulled into the Avengers' fight in Captain America: Civil War (2016). Sharp senses, still learning.

ranks.title: Iron Man
ranks.reason: A genius who built his first suit in a cave in Iron Man (2008) and kept upgrading.

ranks.title: Captain America
ranks.reason: Born in 1918 and asleep in the ice for almost 70 years, so he has seen a lot of history.
ranks.source: Captain America: The First Avenger (2011), Fury: "You've been asleep, Cap, for almost 70 years"; 1918 birth year on the Smithsonian exhibit in Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014)

ranks.title: Thor
ranks.reason: Around 1,500 years old, as he tells Rocket in Avengers: Infinity War (2018). Centuries of stories.

ranks.title: Doctor Strange
ranks.reason: Looked through 14,000,605 possible futures in Avengers: Infinity War (2018).

ranks.title: The Ancient One
ranks.reason: Sorcerer Supreme who trained Doctor Strange in Doctor Strange (2016) and explains how the Infinity Stones hold time together in Avengers: Endgame (2019).

ranks.title: The Watcher
ranks.reason: Sees across the whole multiverse in the animated series What If...? (2021). You found every hidden detail.
